about_the_game:
Lucha Masters: Mighty Lucha – We’re about to tell you a story of adventure, betrayal, friendship... and tacos. Just like any good Mexican telenovela.

This is an action game where up to 4 players can dive into frenetic battles thanks to amazing gameplay, memorable characters, and retro 8-bit aesthetics.
Inspired by authentic Mexican legends and myths, the music, colors, enemies, and levels will make you vibrate with a unique atmosphere full of Lucha Libre. It’s time to become a true luchador!

Play alongside Lucho, a small axolotl with a big mission: defeat the evil IRONMOL-cajete, break piñatas, eat tacos... and get fit! (Although, let’s be honest, that last one is the hardest part).

Embark on great adventures solo or in co-op mode, crossing through various colorful places until you face the evil IRONMOL-cajete (It’s a robot with AI that turned piñatas evil! Can you imagine that? An evil piñata? How sad…).

If you're tired of that sadness, fix it by hitting your friend with a chair or many other things! (We say it in the game, not in real life). In Lucha Mode, up to 4 players can grab and beat each other uncontrollably.

Face evil, create a revolution, overthrow the system, eat tons of tacos, have fun, and become a LEGEND. Never forget that.

short_description: Lucha Masters: Mighty Lucha is a fast-paced action game where up to 4 players brawl through thrilling adventures! With retro 8-bit vibes, unforgettable characters, co-op mayhem, and a spicy dose of Mexican culture, it’s time to step into the ring and prove who’s the real luchador!
